metadata.question: Does cloud cover increase in Western Australia (specifically (-20.59, 125.93)) between 11:00 and 14:00 local time on January 14, 2020?

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Define geometry and time
point = ee.Geometry.Point([125.93, -20.59])
date_start = '2020-01-14'
date_end = '2020-01-15'

# 2. Attempt Sentinel-2 L2A (has cloud info via SCL band)
s2_col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') \
    .filterBounds(point) \
    .filterDate(date_start, date_end) \
    .sort('system:time_start')

size_s2 = s2_col.size().getInfo()
print(f"Sentinel-2 images on 2020-01-14: {size_s2}")

if size_s2 == 0:
    # Try Landsat 8 as fallback
    l8_col = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') \
        .filterBounds(point) \
        .filterDate(date_start, date_end) \
        .sort('system:time_start')
    size_l8 = l8_col.size().getInfo()
    print(f"Landsat 8 images on 2020-01-14: {size_l8}")
    
    if size_l8 == 0:
        print("No satellite data available for location/date.")
        print("C1")
    else:
        # Check Landsat data
        img = l8_col.first()
        # Landsat uses QA_PIXEL band; bit 3 = cloud
        qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL')
        cloud_mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(8).eq(0)  # 0 = not cloud
        cloud_cover_pct = 100 * (1 - cloud_mask.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=point, scale=30, maxPixels=1e9
        ).get('QA_PIXEL').getInfo())
        print(f"Landsat Cloud Cover: {cloud_cover_pct:.1f}%")
        print("Note: Only 1 image available; cannot compare time periods.")
        print("C1")
else:
    # Process Sentinel-2 images
    print(f"Processing {size_s2} Sentinel-2 image(s)...")
    
    # Extract cloud cover from SCL band (Scene Classification Layer)
    # SCL: 3=cloud shadow, 8=cloud medium prob, 9=cloud high prob, 10=thin cirrus
    def calc_cloud_cover(img):
        scl = img.select('SCL')
        cloud_pixels = scl.gte(8)  # Clouds are classes 8, 9, 10
        cloud_pct = cloud_pixels.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=point, scale=20, maxPixels=1e9
        ).get('SCL')
        return img.set('cloud_cover_frac', cloud_pct)
    
    s2_with_cloud = s2_col.map(calc_cloud_cover)
    
    # Get all cloud cover values
    cloud_data = s2_with_cloud.aggregate_array('cloud_cover_frac').getInfo()
    print(f"Cloud cover fractions: {cloud_data}")
    
    if len(cloud_data) == 0:
        print("No valid cloud data extracted.")
        print("C2")
    elif len(cloud_data) == 1:
        # Only one image; cannot compare times
        cc_pct = cloud_data[0] * 100 if cloud_data[0] is not None else None
        print(f"Single image cloud cover: {cc_pct:.1f}%")
        print("Only 1 image available; cannot compare 11:00-14:00 times.")
        print("C1")
    else:
        # Multiple images: compare cloud cover trend
        # Note: Sentinel-2 overpass is ~10:30 UTC = 18:30 WA time, not 11:00-14:00
        cc_pcts = [c*100 if c is not None else None for c in cloud_data]
        cc_pcts = [c for c in cc_pcts if c is not None]
        
        if len(cc_pcts) < 2:
            print(f"Insufficient valid cloud data: {cc_pcts}")
            print("C3")
        else:
            cc_start = cc_pcts[0]
            cc_end = cc_pcts[-1]
            print(f"Cloud cover 1st pass: {cc_start:.1f}%")
            print(f"Cloud cover last pass: {cc_end:.1f}%")
            print(f"Change: {cc_end - cc_start:.1f} percentage points")
            
            if cc_end > cc_start:
                print("A")
            else:
                print("B")
